Compare two official runs

Source: R/batch.R
compare_batches.Rd

What changed between two batch folders of a study (list_batches()): their inputs – the data, by the md5 data_manifest.csv records, and the code, by the md5 of the files of code/, where both runs kept them – and their results (output/). After a fix to the data or the programs, it says whether only what was fixed changed.

Usage

compare_batches(study, batch, against = NULL)

Arguments

study

An rtfstudy.

batch

A batch folder's name (list_batches()$batch): the later run.

against

The earlier one; NULL: the run of the same kind (ARD, reports, both) before batch.

Value

A data frame, kind ("data", "code", "output"), file, result; with attr(, "batches") (against, batch) and attr(, "changed") (a list: the inputs and the outputs that changed).

Details

A result is "identical" (the same bytes), "same but the time" (a report or a status file the same but the date and time it prints or records), "same object" (an .rds read the same), "different", "not made" (the earlier run made it, this one did not) or "new". An input is "added", "removed" or "changed" (one the same is not listed); "not kept" when either run did not keep that input.

Examples

# \donttest{
home <- tempfile()
old <- options(tflplanner.home = home)
setup_tflplanner(studies_root = file.path(home, "studies"))
#> tflplanner home: /tmp/Rtmpz2z3lX/file19e135784d7d
#> new studies go to: /tmp/Rtmpz2z3lX/file19e135784d7d/studies
s <- create_study("CMP", planner = add_output(new_planner(), "T-1"))
d <- file.path(s$path, "runs")
# two batch folders as two official runs leave them (the second made a
# different RTF)
for (b in c("20260101_100000_report", "20260102_100000_report")) {
  dir.create(file.path(d, b, "output", "tfl"), recursive = TRUE)
  writeLines(b, file.path(d, b, "output", "tfl", "T-1.rtf"))
  writeLines(c("part,program,status", "tfl,programs/tfl/T-1.R,OK"),
             file.path(d, b, "run.csv"))
  writeLines("Finished : 2026-01-01 10:00:00", file.path(d, b, "batch.txt"))
}
compare_batches(s, "20260102_100000_report")
#>     kind               file    result
#> 1   data                     not kept
#> 2   code                     not kept
#> 3 output output/tfl/T-1.rtf different
options(old)
# }
